history.body: Hi, I saw Pearl Residences advertised. We’re looking for a place to stay ourselves—could you share roughly where it is and the starting price?
For an eligible category, the starting reference is about RM302k after rebate. That’s based on the base price, not an all-in unit quote. I’ll confirm the exact location for you too.
Thanks, that gives us a rough idea. Could you share the area or nearest landmark once you’ve confirmed it? We’re trying to work out the commute.

The area is Seberang Jaya. Project materials reference connectivity toward Sunway Carnival Mall, Chai Leng Park and Butterworth, which may help you orient your commute. I don’t yet have a verified exact address or travel times, so I don’t want to guess.
That helps, thanks. Seberang Jaya might work for us; we’ll check it against our daily commute. Do you have a project brochure or map we can look at?

I can confirm it’s in Mukim 1, Seberang Jaya, 13700. I don’t have a verified brochure or map link to share right now, so I’ll check whether there’s a shareable one. That should help you compare the location with your commute.
